content: Yesuusi Woosaba Tamaarsis
Issi gallas Yesuusi issi bessan woossees. Woosaa wursida wode iya tamaaretape issoy, “Godaw, Yohaanisi ba tamaareta woosa tamaarsida mela neka nuna woosa tamaarsa” yaagis.
Yesuusi, “Haysada yaagidi woossite:

content.text: Nu gallasa kathaa hachi hachi nuus imma.

content: Kaallidika, Yesuusi ba tamaaretako yaagis: “Leemisos hintefe issuwas laggey de7ees. I giddi bilahe ba laggiya soo bidi, ‘Ta laggiyaw, miyabay de7iko taw immarki.
Taw lagge gidida issi asi ogepe yin, iyaw aathiyaba dhayas’ yaagiko,
“Iya laggey keetha giddon gididi, ‘Hayyana tana waaysopa, pengey gordetis. Ta naytika taara arsa bolla zin7idosona. Yaaniya gisho, dendada ne koyaba immanaw danda7ike’ yaagiyee?
Ta hintew odayis; laggetetha gisho dendidi immanaw koyonna ixikoka woosan salethida gisho, dendidi koshshiyaba ubba immees.
“Hessa gisho, taani hintew odayis; woossite hintew imetana; koyite hinte demmana; kare yidi xeegite hintew dooyetana.
Gaasoyka, woossiya ubbay ekees; koyey demmees; kare yidi xeegeysas dooyetees.
“Hinteno, aawato hinte giddofe na7i uythi woossin, shuchu immey oonee? Molo woossin shooshi immey oonee?
Woyko phuuphulle woossiko korne immii?
Hinte iitata gidishe hinte naytas lo77oba immo eriko, salon de7iya hinte aaway woosseysatas Geeshsha Ayyaana waatidi aathidi immennee?” yaagis.
Yesuusanne Bi7eel-Zebuula
Issi gallas Yesuusi, doona muumisida tuna ayyaana issi uraape kessis. Tuna ayyaanay keyida mela muume uray odetis. Asayka malaaletis.
Shin issoti issoti, “Tuna ayyaana halaqa, Bi7eel-Zebuula wolqan tuna ayyaanata kessees” yaagidosona.
Harati qassi paacees salope malla bessaana mela koydosona.
Shin Yesuusi enta qofaa eridi entako, “Woli giddon shaaketiya kawotethi ubbay dhayees; woli giddon shaaketiya keethi kundees.
Xalahey woli giddon shaaketiko iya kawotethay waanidi minnidi eqanee? Hinte tana, ‘I tuna ayyaanata Bi7eel-Zebuula wolqan kessees’ yaageeta.
Hiza, taani tuna ayyaana Bi7eel-Zebuula wolqan kessiyaba gidiko hinte nayti oodde wolqan kessonaasha? Hessa gisho, enti hinte bolla pirdeyisata gidana.
Shin taani tuna ayyaanata Xoossa biradhen kessiyaba gidiko, hiza, Xoossaa kawotethay hinteko matidaysa erite.
“Mino asi tooranne gondalle oykidi, ba keetha naagiyaba gidiko, iya shaloy boshetenna.
Hanoshin, iyape aadhidi mino gidida asi yidi, iya qohidi xooniko, ammanetida tooranne gondalle wosisi ekidi, iya shaluwa bonqidi haras shaakees.
“Taara gidonaysi tana ixees; taara shiishonnaysi laallees.
“Tuna ayyaanay asape keyda wode shempiya bessi koydi haathi bayna soora yuuyees. Shempiya bessi dhayda wode, ‘Ta keydasuwa simmana’ yaagees.
I simmiya wode keethay pitetidi lo77idi de7ishin demmis.
Hessafe guye, bidi iyape aadhidi iitida hara laapun tuna ayyaanata ekidi yees. Iyan gelidi duussu oykees. He uraas koyroysafe aadhidi guyeysi iita gidees” yaagis.
Yesuusi hessa oda bolla de7ishin, issi maccasi asaa gaathafe dendada, ba qaala dhoqu oothada, “Nena tookida uloynne neeni dhammida dhanthati anjetidosona” yaagasu.
Shin I, “Anjetidaysati Xoossaa qaala si7idi kiiteteyisata” yaagis.
Yoonasa Malaata
Daro asay shiiqida wode Yesuusi, “Ha yeletethay iita yeletethi; ooratha malla koyees. Shin Yoonasa malaatape attishin, hari entaw imetenna.
Yoonasi Nanawe asaas malla gidida mela Asa Na7ika ha yeletethaas malla gidana.
Dugeha kawiya pirda gallas ha yeletethaara dendada pirdana. Gaasoyka, iya Solomone cincatethaa si7anaw biitta gaxape dendada yasu. Heko Solomonepe aadhey haysan de7ees
Nanawe asati pirda gallas ha yeletethaara dendidi enta bolla pirdana. Gaasoyka, Yoonasa sibkatiyan maarota gelidosona. Heko, Yoonasape aadhey haysan de7ees” yaagis.
Asatetha Poo7o
“Xompe oythidi qosa bessan woyko oto giddon wothiya asi deenna. Asi poo7uwa be7ana mela dhoqa bessan wothees.
Ne asatethaas poo7oy ne ayfiya. Ne ayfey lo77o gidiko, ne kumetha asatethay poo7ees. Nena ayfey sakiko ne asatethay ubbay dhumees.
Hessa gisho, ne garsan de7iya poo7oy dhumonna mela naageta.
Hiza, ne kumetha asatethay poo7o gidiko, ne asatethanka hari dhuma bessi dhayiko, ne asatethaa kumethay wolile poo7o mela gidees” yaagis.
Usupun Ayyeta
Yesuusi ba oda ongida mela issi Farsaawey baara kathi maana mela xeegis. Yesuusi, iyara issife gelidi gibira bolla uttis.
Farsaawey Yesuusi kathi maanape sinthe kushe meecconaysa be7idi malaaletis.
Goday iyako, “Hinte Farsaaweti quulesinne shaates bolla bagga meeceta. Shin hinte gaathay uuzetethaninne iitatethan kumis.
Hinteno, eeyato, kare bagga medhiday, gaatha bagga medhiday iya gidennee?
Shin quuliyaninne shaatiyan de7eysa manqotas immite. He wode hintew ubbabay geeshshi gidana.
“Farsaaweto hintena ayye! Sawope, xalootepenne hessa melabaape asraata kesseeta. Shin xillotethinne Xoosse dosoy hintenan baawa. Harata aggonna haysataka oothanaw bessees, shin aggideta.
“Farsaaweto hintena ayye! Ayhude woosa keethan boncho oyde, giya giddon boncho sarotho doseeta.
“Mali dhayin, asay eronna bollara biya duufo daaneysato hintena ayye!” yaagis.
Higge astamaarey zaaridi, “Astamaariyaw, ne hessa gashe nuna cayaasa” yaagis.
Yesuusi, “Hinteno, higge astamaareto, hintenaka ayye! Asay tookanaw danda7onna deexo tooho toosseta, shin hinte hinte huuphes hari attoshin biradhe xeeranka bocheketa.
“Hinte aawati wodhida nabeta duufuwa hinte giigisiya gisho, hintena ayye!
Hiza, hinte aawata oosuwa minthanaw enti wodhida nabeta duufuwa hinte loythiya gisho, enta iita oosuwas hinte marka.
Hessa gisho, Xoossay ba cincatethan, ‘Nabetanne hawaareta ta hintew kiittana, shin hinte baggata wodhana; harata gooddana’ yaagis.
Ha yeletethay alamey medhetoosape hanno gakanaw gukida nabeta ubbaa suuthas oyshetana.
Aabelape doomidi yarsho bessaasinne xoossa keethafe gidduwan gukida Zakaryaasa suutha gisho ha yeletethay oyshetana.
“Higge astamaareto, hintena ayye! Eratetha qulpiya hinte kushen oykideta, shin hintew geleketa harataka gelseketa” yaagis.
Yesuusi yaape baanaw keyiya wode, higge astamaaretinne Farsaaweti iyara eqetidi oyshon waaysosona.
Iya doonape keyiya qaalan iya oykanaw koydi hessa oothidosona.
